item.title: The Odyssey's Most Disturbing Scene Barely Used Any CGI. Here's How They Pulled It Off.
item.description: Christopher Nolan's The Odyssey arrives on digital, 4K Ultra HD and Blu-ray on Nov. 17, giving audiences another opportunity to experience the filmmaker's ambitious adaptation of Homer's epic poem. Among the story's many memorable encounters is Circe, a powerful sorceress who turns Odysseus' men into pigs. Played by Samantha Morton, Circe is responsible for one of the film's most unsettling sequences, which involves a human head being transformed into that of a pig.

item.title: Marvel’s Newest Superhero Was Created to Solve a Major Magic: The Gathering Problem
item.description: In an interview with Polygon at MagicCon: Atlanta, Magic vice president of design Aaron Forsythe talked about the unique approach that Marvel and Wizards of the Coast are taking for the game’s third crossover set, specifically about the development of a unique character that will feature prominently in Darkhold Destiny and the accompanying Marvel Comics.

item.title: Nintendo Fans Blast New Switch 2 Release as ‘Paid Downgrade’
item.description: So far, the Nintendo Switch 2 upgraded editions of games originally released on the Switch have been a bit of a mixed bag. While games like Kirby and the Forgotten Land received significant new content and noticeable performance upgrades, others such as Xenoblade Chronicles X weren’t quite as well received. According to many Pikmin fans, the recently released Switch 2 version of Pikmin 4 falls into the latter camp.

item.title: Obsession Director Officially Casts Horror Icon in Next Film
item.description: Curry Barker's Obsession is one of the year's best horror films, but his next movie might end up being even better . Barker is writing, directing, and starring in next year's Anything but Ghosts , and he'll be joined by a horror movie icon.

item.title: Event Habitat Dex and Pokédex list in Pokémon Pokopia
item.description: Pokémon Pokopia has limited-time events that occur for a few days before disappearing, though you can time travel back to them, if you miss out on any. Some events feature Pokémon and habitats you can only unlock via the event, so you'll want to make sure you're paying attention to any guests who are the "talk of the town."

item.title: Christopher Nolan's The Odyssey Gives Percy Jackson a Massive Streaming Boost on Disney Plus
item.description: Everybody and their mother became obsessed with Greek mythology this summer thanks to Christopher Nolan's latest box-office hit, The Odyssey . It turns out people were so hungry for more that they went out searching for it in other movies, books, and TV shows. One beneficiary of that was Disney Plus' Percy Jackson and the Olympians , which got a much-needed boost prior to the premiere of its third season .

item.title: Pokémon Pokopia 'Apples to Applin' event guide
item.description: Pokémon Pokopia 's "Apples to Applin" event comes to make your islands sweeter with the help of Applin. The cute little apple Pokémon is excited about checking new places, but it wishes to acquire Syrupy Apples, which you'll only find on some unique islands. But once you collect some, you can exchange Applin's favorite fruits for beautiful apple-themed decorations.

item.title: Pokémon Go 'Dynamax Trails' event guide
item.description: Pokémon Go ’s "Dynamax Trails" event celebrates Dynamax Pokémon, as well as brings back Eternatus for those who missed out on it last year. You can use this event stock up on Eternatus Candy, and it runs from Nov. 16-23 .

item.title: Goodbye Zelda: Ocarina of Time, Hello GTA VI Release!
item.description: The Switch 2 remake of The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time has been one of the biggest hits for gaming so far this year. With such a beloved video game franchise, there is always a certain amount of apprehension about remakes, especially when it is something that holds a certain level of nostalgia. However, with The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time , the team at Nintendo clearly took care to reintroduce fans to a beloved world.
